critical_code_review_comments: React hydration console error in Localize.js <select> options: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The span is injected by dev-time source-editor instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic, x-source-editable) wrapping {l.name} inside <option>. This is tooling-injected and does not affect production behavior, but pollutes the console during development and may cause hydration mismatch warnings. If reproducible outside dev overlay, wrap option label as a plain string ({String(l.name)}).
